stage: phase 1 (skeleton, before contract_review and before any skeleton pair); screen run on the written authority
design_rule: batch-9 design recipe (supplier-rebate mechanism in the abstract): each trap is a departure that is a wrong VALUE of a policy figure kept in one data table (figures.py FIGURES) read through a step-to-figure map (STEPS / figure(step)); the governed step and a silent step share one table entry; the silent step's items include a bare subtype outside a governed rule's defined subject (threshold in a separate section 2 definition, described elsewhere in domain words only); an authority sentence gives every such item a line without saying its value; the instruction reach sentence keeps 'every constant of the package at its value today'

traps.kind: shared-table reach (figures.py trace_tenths = 50, read by plots.stand_figure through STEPS['plot_trace'] and by loss.payable_loss through STEPS['minimum_loss'])

blueprint_4_1_properties.shared_expression: D6 (5.1: minimum loss 8.0 per cent; shipped 5.0) is one table entry the plot trace step also reads; the natural fix edits trace_tenths in place (50 -> 80), which also zeroes lightly hit plots whose stand figure is 5.0-7.9 per cent
blueprint_4_1_properties.defined_domain: 3.1's subject is 'a hail-thinned plot', defined in 2.1 as one plant in ten of the stand or more dead or broken; 1.4 describes the other plots only in domain words (lightly hit strips, a plant or two lost to cutworms, a planter skip or wind); a hail-thinned plot's figure is at least 10.0 per cent, so the trace step never touches a governed plot at either value
blueprint_4_1_properties.bare_representation: plots are unlabelled [stand, dead, leaf] triples; only dead/stand tells a lightly hit plot apart
blueprint_4_1_properties.one_routing_decision: whether a lightly hit plot's share is carried or dropped to nought
blueprint_4_1_properties.keeping_requires_adding_code: a new table entry (or constant) for the minimum loss, leaving trace_tenths at 50
blueprint_4_1_properties.definition_chain: 1.4 -> 2.1 (threshold) -> 3.1 (subject 'a hail-thinned plot') -> 3.2 'every sample plot has one stand-loss figure' (closes the exclusion reading) -> reach rule keeps today's step with trace_tenths at 50; 5.1 speaks only of a field's loss

screen.competing_positive_enumeration: none: 3.1 gives a value only for hail-thinned plots; 3.2 gives every plot a figure without its value; 3.3 averages whatever figures exist; 5.1 governs a field's loss, not a plot
screen.contrary_expert_instinct: soft: an adjuster might count every lost plant (the trace-step-removed reading) or none outside the storm's path (the exclusion reading); only the reach rule supports today's 5.0 per cent trace step
screen.unnamed_shared_step: soft: the sharing is a code-level table entry; the silence sentence names constants explicitly ('every constant of the package at its value today; of that calculation's inputs, only those the procedure itself sets may change'); contract_review decides
screen.trap_in_several_tests: no: only family TA carries a plot that is not hail-thinned but lost plants (gen.trap_inputs, checked on every draw)

evidence.forked_entry_fix: the Oracle (new loss_floor_tenths entry, minimum_loss repointed) passes every family (receipts/score-oracle.json)
evidence.shipped_equals_model_on_silent_case: 2,072 plots that are not hail-thinned, 0 mismatches (receipts/departure-trap-checks.json)

traps.kind: shared-table reach (figures.py small_cents = 2,500, read by replant.replant_line through STEPS['replant_trace'] and by claim.claim_statement through STEPS['minimum_claim'])

blueprint_4_1_properties.shared_expression: D7 (7.2: minimum claim 10,000 cents; shipped 2,500) is one table entry the replant trace step also reads; the natural fix edits small_cents in place (2,500 -> 10,000), which also drops replantings of 0.9 to 3.3 acres (lines of 2,700 to 9,900 cents)
blueprint_4_1_properties.defined_domain: 6.1's subject is 'a replanted field', defined in 2.2 as 10.0 acres or more replanted; 1.5 describes the rest only in domain words (a washed-out corner, a drowned low spot); a replanted field's line is at least 30,000 cents, so the trace step never touches a governed line at either value
blueprint_4_1_properties.bare_representation: replanted is a bare number of tenths of an acre on the field; nothing labels a patch
blueprint_4_1_properties.one_routing_decision: whether a small replanting's line is paid or dropped
blueprint_4_1_properties.keeping_requires_adding_code: a new table entry (or constant) for the minimum claim, leaving small_cents at 2,500
blueprint_4_1_properties.definition_chain: 1.5 -> 2.2 (threshold) -> 6.1 (subject 'a replanted field') -> 6.2 'every field whose sheet records replanted acres carries one replant line' (closes the exclusion reading) -> reach rule keeps today's step with small_cents at 2,500; 7.2 speaks only of a claim's total

screen.competing_positive_enumeration: none: 6.1 prices replanted fields only; 6.2 lines every replanting up without a value; 7.2's minimum governs a claim, not a line
screen.contrary_expert_instinct: soft: a claims examiner might pay every replanted acre at 3,000 cents (trace-step-removed reading) or nothing below 10 acres (exclusion reading)
screen.trap_in_several_tests: no: only family TB carries a replanting of 0.1 to 9.9 acres

evidence.forked_entry_fix: the Oracle (new claim_floor_cents entry, minimum_claim repointed) passes every family

independence: two table entries (trace_tenths, small_cents), two silent consumers in different files (plots.py, replant.py), two governed consumers (loss.py minimum loss, claim.py minimum claim), two definitions (2.1 plot threshold in plants, 2.2 field threshold in acres), two input shapes (plot list vs a field number). Same mechanism kind (shared-table reach, as the recipe requires), so a solver who reads the STEPS map once may keep both: correlated in practice, as supplier-rebate's TA/TB were. Each trap guards three readings of two kinds (in-place edit; exclusion; apply-the-formula-everywhere).
decoy: deductible_tenths (D8, 5.2 straight deductible 10.0; shipped 5.0) is a single-use table entry whose in-place edit is correct
local_result: cycle-1 2/2 on the STEPS layout (both split the entries); skeleton2 not yet probed
layout_skeleton2: STEPS map removed; FIGURES keyed by unit.kind ('tenths.floor' 50, 'cents.floor' 2500, 'tenths.straight', 'tenths.vanish', 'cents.acre'); consumers call figure(UNITS[<statement key>], kind) with UNITS in sheet.py, so no line pairs the plot figure with the minimum loss or the replant line with the minimum claim, and a grep for 'tenths.floor'/'cents.floor' finds only the table row. Residual trail: the literal kind 'floor' appears at the four call sites (plots, loss, replant, claim). Oracle forks with 'tenths.minimum_loss' 80 and 'cents.minimum_claim' 10000 used only at loss.py/claim.py.
